says: The rule that linking faults stop the load says items already staged are not removed, but not what that means for the next load. BuildStructures clears RawCategories, RawProducts, RawSupport and RawPolicies only on its last lines (AdmxBundle.vb 178-181), after the throwing steps, and AddSingleAdmx has already put the file in SourceFiles and Namespaces (76-77). So after a linking error the bundle keeps the staged items of every file of that load and never fills the final lists, and any later LoadFolder or LoadFile on the same bundle runs BuildStructures over the same staged items and fails the same way, until a new bundle is made. State this consequence in the duplicate-name rule or in the policy missing-reference rule (or as one rule on a failed link), since it decides what a person can do after such an error. The code does not show whether a calling screen discards the bundle, so keep the existing assumption about the caller's handling.
